create_json_dataset: create a JsonDataset instance from a registered COCO json dataset name to load annotations and categories
get_roidb_with_gt: get an roidb with ground truth boxes and densepose annotations from a JsonDataset instance
add_proposals_to_roidb: add proposal boxes from a pickle file to an existing roidb with crowd filtering support
filter_crowd_proposals: filter proposals that overlap crowd regions above a threshold using COCO mask IoU computation
init_keypoints_for_person: initialize COCO keypoint metadata and flip mappings for the person category in a dataset
